title: DXF text index
description: Every piece of text in one DXF (`extract_text`): TEXT, MTEXT, ATTRIB, MULTILEADER text, DIMENSION override text, in modelspace and paper-space layouts, and the same kinds found inside INSERTed blocks (recursively, with a block_path). ATTDEFs are listed apart as definitions: they are not visible text. Nothing is interpreted. Entry order is deterministic (layouts in tab order, entities in file order, an INSERT's attributes then its block content depth-first). Handles are valid only for this conversion of the drawing; entries from block content are virtual copies and have no handle (see definition_handle). Encoding is decided from FONT NAMES (encoding.font_hint) and an approved knowledge-table row (knowledge/font-encodings.csv); the only thing read from the text itself is code-point evidence: a Vietnamese letter or tone mark that single-byte legacy text cannot hold proves Unicode. Values are capped at file.confidence_cap (ADR-0005); 'high' is only given to text whose font is a known Unicode family. 'status' is 'partial' when at least one entity raised: it is listed in summary.errors and absent from entries; 'unreadable' carries only file, attempts and error.

path.description: The file as recorded, also in every provenance.file: relative to the project input folder when written by `harness intake` (for a DWG, the DWG itself; sha256 is that of the converted DXF that was read); the path as given for `harness extract-text`.

handles_reliable.description: Same rule as the dxf-probe: false for R12-era files without stored handles; then every handle is null.

codepage.description: Python codec of the file's text: 'utf8' for R2007+ files (whatever $DWGCODEPAGE says), else the code page ezdxf used. Anything other than utf8/cp1252/latin-1 triggers a re-encode before legacy conversion (unvalidated on real files).

error.description: Why the file could not be read. Only when status is 'unreadable'.

attdefs.description: ATTDEF definitions of every non-xref block. Not visible text; values are defaults.

encoding_used.description: unicode: a known Unicode family, or code-point evidence (source codepoint_evidence), or an approved knowledge row. tcvn3 / vni: a '.Vn...' / 'VNI-...' font name or an approved knowledge row; the text was converted. unknown: neither the font name nor an approved row says anything (SHX, VntimeH, Calibri...); the text is kept as stored, never converted. mixed: an MTEXT whose runs use different encodings (see run_details).

source.description: What decided the encoding. Precedence when runs differ: codepoint_evidence (a Vietnamese letter above U+00FF or a tone mark proves Unicode, whatever the font; confidence capped at medium), knowledge_table (an approved row, listed in knowledge_patterns; text style runs only; confidence capped at medium), mtext_inline_font (any run had an inline \F font switch), style_font (font_hint on the style name or its font file), style_family (font_hint on the TrueType family name of the style's ACAD XDATA, tried after the style name and the font file). none: nothing gave an encoding.

knowledge_patterns.description: Patterns of the approved knowledge rows that decided a run (distinct, in order); empty when none did. Proposed rows are never listed: they decide nothing (flag proposed_knowledge_row).

capital_font.description: font_hint capital-font hint (style or inline font name ends in 'H'), combined over runs; null when absent or conflicting. A hint, not a fact.

case_uncertain.description: True when ambiguous_count > 0: the case of some letters is a guess (TCVN3 has no toned capitals; capital fonts draw a-z as capitals). The decoded text keeps lowercase.

unmapped_count.description: Characters the converter has no table entry for (kept as stored).

nfd_damaged.description: Combining marks found in text decoded as legacy: it was decomposed upstream, the conversion cannot be trusted.

runs.description: MTEXT runs of constant inline font (1 for single-line text).

mixed_fonts.description: More than one distinct font among the runs.

font.description: Inline font family; null when the text style applies.

capital_font.description: Null for a run proved Unicode by code points.

knowledge_pattern.description: Pattern of the approved knowledge row that decided this run; null otherwise.

id.description: Sequential in output order; stable for the same file and ezdxf version.

space.description: 'model' or the paper-space layout name. Text found in an INSERTed block keeps the space of the top-level INSERT; block_path says it is in a block.

layout.description: Layout (tab) name; 'Model' for modelspace. Kept apart from provenance.sheet, which is 'unknown' because the printed sheet number is not read here.

coordinate_frame.description: wcs: modelspace (and block content placed in it), world coordinates. paper: paper-space layout coordinates (sheet units), NOT model coordinates.

layer.description: Effective layer. Inside a block, an entity on layer '0' takes the layer of the INSERT it came through (AutoCAD rule); definition_layer then holds '0'.

layer_state.description: State of the effective layer in the layer table only; viewport freezes are not evaluated.

style.description: Text style name; for DIMENSION the dimension style's text style; null when unresolved.

font_file.description: Font file of the style as stored (SHX or TTF); null when the style is unknown. Availability is not checked.

basis.description: Which stored point this is. align_point: TEXT/ATTRIB with a non-left/baseline alignment (the displayed anchor). context_block_insert: MULTILEADER block content, the position of its block, not of the attribute.

alignment.description: ezdxf alignment name (TEXT: LEFT, MIDDLE_CENTER, ...; MTEXT: TOP_LEFT, ...).

height.description: Text or character height in drawing units, as stored (after block transforms for block content). Null when not stored.

rotation.description: Degrees, as stored (OCS for TEXT/ATTRIB; see the non_default_extrusion flag).

handle.description: Handle of the entity. For DIMENSION entries the dimension's handle. Null for virtual block content and when handles_reliable is false.

definition_handle.description: Block content only: handle of the entity in the block definition it was copied from.

block_path.description: Block names from the top-level INSERT down to the block definition holding the entity. Empty for entities not inside a block. An ATTRIB belongs to an INSERT, so its path stops before that INSERT's own block (block_name).

insert_handles.description: Same length as block_path: handle of the INSERT through which each block was entered (null for nested, virtual INSERTs).

tag.description: ATTRIB tag, or the attribute definition tag of a MULTILEADER block attribute. Grid labels live here.

block_name.description: ATTRIB only: name of the block of the INSERT that owns the attribute.

insert_handle.description: ATTRIB only: handle of the owning INSERT (null if virtual).

invisible.description: ATTRIB only: the invisible flag. Invisible attributes are kept, flagged attribute_invisible.

text_rule.description: DIMENSION only. override: text typed over the measurement. measured_with_text: contains '<>' (measurement placeholder) with a prefix or suffix. Pure measured values are the probe's job.

raw_text.description: As stored: MTEXT with all inline codes, '%%' codes unexpanded, legacy bytes undecoded.

plain_text.description: raw_text with MTEXT formatting codes removed (ezdxf MTextParser, as `plain_mtext` does) and '\n' for paragraph breaks. Legacy bytes NOT decoded and '%%' codes NOT expanded: ezdxf's own plain_text() expands %%c before any decoding, which is the order hazard.

decoded_text.description: plain_text after legacy conversion (NFC), '%%' codes still as written. Equal to plain_text for unicode and unknown encodings.

display_text.description: decoded_text with special codes expanded AFTER decoding: %%c -> U+00D8, %%d -> U+00B0, %%p -> U+00B1, %%% -> '%' (the ezdxf table; U+00D8 is the Latin letter O with stroke, not the diameter sign U+2300). %%u %%o %%k are removed. Unknown '%%' sequences stay as written (flag unknown_special_code).

special_codes.description: Distinct known '%%x' codes found, lower-cased, in order of first appearance.

flags.description: Reasons a reader should look twice: dxf_unicode_escape_decoded (\U+XXXX turned into the character), mif_escape_not_decoded (\M+ multibyte escape left as written), encoding_unknown_non_ascii, codepage_reencode_failed, unknown_special_code, mixed_fonts, inline_font_unknown, unicode_evidence_contradicts_font (Unicode letters in a run whose font said TCVN3 or VNI: not converted), eth_for_d_stroke (U+00D0 Eth, which looks like the Vietnamese D-stroke, inside Vietnamese Unicode text: kept as stored, never replaced), knowledge_conflict (approved knowledge rows disagree about the text style: undecided), proposed_knowledge_row (a proposed knowledge row matches the text style: not applied), style_not_found, style_unresolved, layer_off, layer_frozen, layer_from_insert, attribute_invisible, non_default_extrusion, block_content_attribute, position_is_block_insert, legacy_ascii_suspect (pure-ASCII text that matches a pattern legacy Vietnamese text takes when stored as ASCII, in a TCVN3 / VNI style, or of unknown encoding when its style name, font file or family looks like a legacy Vietnamese font name or its font file holds non-ASCII text of unknown encoding: the legacy-font gate blocks it).

provenance.description: sheet is always 'unknown' at this stage; method is dxf_dimension_text for DIMENSION entries, dxf_entity otherwise.

default_text.description: Raw default value, not decoded. A constant attribute shows this text on every insert and never becomes an ATTRIB.

depth_limit_count.description: INSERTs holding text that were not expanded because the nesting limit was reached.

cycle_count.description: INSERTs not expanded because their block already appears in the path (a block that contains itself).

missing_block_inserts.description: INSERTs whose block definition does not exist.

empty_text_skipped.description: TEXT/MTEXT/ATTRIB/... with empty or blank text: counted, not indexed.

dimensions_without_override.description: Dimensions that show the pure measurement (or no text): measured values are the probe's job.

transform_skipped.description: Block entities ezdxf's virtual_entities() could not transform (reported through its skipped_entity_callback).

errors.description: Entities whose processing raised (first 200). Each is absent from entries; status is 'partial' when any exist.
